page.overview:
Who is Carlton?

Carlton is the sixteenth boss that Toad faces in VS COM mode of the SNES version of Wario's Woods. He is a knight (or possibly a sentient suit of armor) found guarding the castle. He is also an astute thinker, and is confident that he can deduce all possibilities in his fight against Toad with math. After Toad wins the game against Carlton, he is seen kneeling before Toad perhaps out of newfound respect.
